dimensions.assessment: Directs federal agency actions involving the Department of State, USAID, and the President, with indirect implications for border communities and international partners.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of State to develop a strategy on efforts to strengthen subnational cooperation between the United States and Mexico

dimensions.assessment: Mandates strategic reports, reviews, updates, and notifications rather than altering domestic laws or implementing direct funding programs.
Directs reviews of financial access, programs, and resource provisions, but provides no specific funding amounts or economic projections.
Requires interagency reporting, congressional notifications, and limitations on data sharing until specified conditions are met.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State may not carry out any project, program, or activity that implements the strategy under subsection (a) for the purpose specified in paragraph (1)(C)... until the Secretary submits... a notification

dimensions.assessment: Requires a strategy within 270 days and an update within two years, representing medium-term reporting obligations.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State... shall submit... a strategy

missing_information: No specific funding authorizations or cost estimates are provided in the text.
The specific contents of the future strategies and reviews are not predetermined.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires executive branch officials to develop and submit strategic plans, updates, and reviews regarding subnational cooperation with Mexico and financial access in CARICOM member states, engaging federal agencies and congressional committees.
